description: Google Ad Manager ad requests on pubads.g.doubleclick.net/gampad/ads and securepubads.g.doubleclick.net/gampad/ads. Google documents iu as the ad unit path. Floodlight activity tags stay vendor/floodlight. CM360 VAST events stay vendor/cm360-vast-event.

params.name: iu
params.description: It is the ad unit path, including the network code, in the form /network_code/.../ad_unit. Google documents iu as required to implement ad serving.
params.fix_hint: Set iu to the Ad Manager ad unit path, such as /6062/videodemo.
